name: VitalOryx
tagline: Understand everyday wellness metrics through transparent educational calculators.

tool.title: Adult BMI Calculator
tool.intro: Calculate body mass index from height and weight using the standard metric equation.
tool.formula: BMI = weight in kilograms ÷ (height in meters) squared. It is a screening metric, not a diagnosis.
tool.caution: BMI has important limitations and is not suitable for individual medical decisions. Consult a qualified clinician when needed.
